title: Cross-team Engineering Leadership Weekly Staff Notes - 2026-06-29
content:
Meeting: Cross-team Engineering Leadership Weekly Staff
Date: 2026-06-29 09:30-10:30 PT
Location: Zoom / #eng-leadership
Attendees: Ethan Park (note), Priya Nair, Liam O'Connor, Maria Gomez, Zoe Tan, Anika Shah, Brent Kim, Jordan Li

Agenda:
- Quick metrics roundup
- Team updates (serving runtime, platform, observability, private deployments, release eng, SRE)
- Blockers & risks
- Rollout plan for v1.8 kernels + canary schedule
- Action items and owners

Quick metrics:
- p95 latency (text-gen small models): 145ms (goal <150ms)
- Token-per-second throughput (cluster avg): +9% week-over-week after batching changes
- Error rate (5xx): 0.9% (up from 0.6% last week) - spike correlated with autoscaler churn on dedicated pools
- Cost per 1M tok (hosted): down 6% after KV cache improvements

Highlights / Updates by team:
- Serving Runtime (Priya):
  - v1.8 kernel rollout is green on internal perf tests. Regressions for long-context attention fixed (PR 412).
  - Observed CPU spike on hetero nodes during KV cache warmup; investigating late-binding heuristic.
  - Plan: start internal canary tomorrow (2026-06-30) with 5% traffic, expand to 25% by Fri if stable.

- Platform Engineering (Liam):
  - Autoscaler tuning merged for Dedicated pools (PLAT-879). Expect reduced scale-flapping.
  - Working on migration to new instance family in us-west-2; migration window drafted.

- Observability (Maria):
  - Added token-level tracing hooks to debug cache cold-starts. Retention for traces increased to 7 days for the canary window.
  - Dashboard updated: canary traffic route + p99 per-model. Link in artifacts.

- Private Deployments (Zoe):
  - Completed partner integration smoke tests for VPC control-plane. Two customers in sandbox for pilot.
  - Need guidance on KMS key rotation policy for on-prem package - security team follow-up requested.

- Release Engineering (Brent):
  - Cut release candidate rc-1 for v1.8. Packaging and upgrade scripts included.
  - Coordinating canary rollback playbook with SRE.

- SRE (Anika):
  - Investigating 5xx uptick during autoscale events. Preliminary hypothesis: race between router health checks and instance readiness. Proposing 3s readiness delay and improved draining.
  - Runbook updated; will run chaos test next Tue to validate.

Blockers & Risks:
- Autoscaler flapping (Dedicated) can cause transient 5xxs for customers on reserved pools. Priority: medium-high. Owner: Liam.
- KV cache warmup CPU spike could increase cost during high churn. Owner: Priya. Need mitigation by end of canary window or we will throttle canary expansion.
- KMS rotation guidance required for Private on-prem deployments before pilot expands. Owner: Zoe + Security.

Decisions made:
- Proceed with v1.8 canary tomorrow at 5% traffic; hard stop for expansion if 5xx > 1.5% or p95 latency > 200ms for 15m.
- Apply autoscaler tuning to one Dedicated fleet as pilot; monitor for 48h before broader rollout.

Action items (owner - due):
- Priya: Instrument KV warmup path with per-thread CPU metrics + flag to disable late-binding heuristic if spike > threshold (due 2026-07-01)
- Liam: Roll autoscaler tuning to pilot dedicated fleet and report stability metrics (SERV-1023) (due 2026-07-01)
- Maria: Add canary-specific dashboards and alerts; create alert runbook for 5xx spike during scale events (due 2026-06-30)
- Zoe: Draft KMS rotation policy options for on-prem customers and align with Security (due 2026-07-03)
- Brent: Finalize rc-1 release notes and rollback playbook; share in #eng-releases (due 2026-06-30)
- Anika: Run chaos test validating readiness/drain changes and share results (due 2026-07-06)

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Longer-term: evaluate more conservative autoscaler backoff strategies and proactive warm pools for high-churn tenants.
- Post-canary retrospective scheduled for 2026-07-07 to review metrics and decide GA timing.

Notes / Misc:
- Linked artifacts include the release plan and PRs. Please comment on PR 412 by EOD if you see edge-case regressions.
- Next meeting: 2026-07-06 09:30 PT

Minutes prepared by: Ethan Park
